title.zh: 叶琉照 · 先布后帷幕与升级启动
title.en: Ye / Dialyn / Zhao · Paper before Veil and upgraded entry

summary.zh: 本站据原作者与固定机制整理：琉音先布，照开帷幕，叶按资源或真实升级Q启动。非逐帧原轴。
summary.en: DUKE synthesis of authored methods and fixed mechanics: Dialyn applies Paper, Zhao opens a Veil, and Ye starts from resources or a real upgraded Ultimate. Not a frame timeline.

conditions.zh: 循环站位琉音→照→叶瞬光，可整体旋转；叶为主攻。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Dialyn → Zhao → Ye Shunguang; rotations are equivalent and Ye is the attacker.

conditions.zh: 基础0影无专武可用；先看资源，不预设开局6剑势或所有终结技就绪。
conditions.en: Usable at M0 without signatures; check resources instead of assuming six opening Force or every Ultimate ready.

conditions.zh: 叶的资源登场、本人耗喧响Q、免费升级Q不是同一种启动；收尾按真实资格选择。
conditions.en: Ye’s resource Entry, personal Decibel-paid Ultimate and free upgraded Ultimate differ; choose the finisher from real eligibility.

conditions.zh: 本站据原作者正文和固定3.3基础机制整理；不是逐帧原轴，不承诺固定秒数、旧排名或最高分。
conditions.en: DUKE synthesis of authored text and fixed 3.3 base mechanics; not an authored frame timeline, fixed-duration rotation, historical ranking or maximum-score claim.

conditions.zh: 先布再让目标进入叶的决裁；帷幕易伤替代本次失衡易伤，不双重相乘。
conditions.en: Apply Paper before the target enters Ye’s Verdict; Veil vulnerability replaces the Stun multiplier rather than multiplying both.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 叶琉照／嘉照叶与明心境操作（2.5）
label.en: Little Orange · Ye teams and Enlightened Mind (2.5)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 照的登场与后台蓄力（2.5）
label.en: Little Orange · Zhao entry and off-field charging (2.5)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 琉音猜拳与连携升级（2.4）
label.en: Little Orange · Dialyn RPS and upgraded Chains (2.4)

objective.zh: 先建立辅助，按剑势决定普通入场还是明心。
objective.en: Establish support, then use real Sword Force to choose entry.

title.zh: 先给目标挂布，再开叶的帷幕
title.en: Apply Paper before opening Ye’s Veil

input.zh: 普通切琉音；资源足时石头→剪刀→布，命中后切照
input.en: Switch normally to Dialyn; with resources use Rock → Scissors → Paper, then switch to Zhao

trigger.zh: 叶还没为本轮目标建立决裁帷幕易伤，或下一轮需要重建；每段EX能量与形态衔接满足。
trigger.en: Ye has not yet established this target’s Verdict vulnerability, or the next cycle needs setup; each EX has energy and a valid form window.

complete.zh: 确认布命中、恶意投诉有效，再让目标进入叶的新帷幕。好评不预设到90。
complete.en: Confirm Paper hits and Malicious Complaint is active before the target enters Ye’s new Veil. Do not prefill 90 Positive Reviews.

reason.zh: 叶读取目标进入帷幕当时的易伤，不能先开帷幕再补布却宣称本轮倍率追补。
reason.en: Ye reads vulnerability when the target enters the Veil; applying Paper afterward does not retroactively refresh that snapshot.

fallback.zh: 已覆盖可省EX，但琉音在前台时仍切照；叶已在明心境就保留现有窗口，勿为补布强行收尾。
fallback.en: Skip EX if covered, but still leave Dialyn for Zhao. If Ye is already Enlightened, preserve that window rather than forcing an early finisher for Paper.

signal.zh: 普通切照；只有接战且霜寒满才发动登场。
signal.en: Switch to Zhao; the Entry Skill requires combat and full Frostbite.

title.zh: 照满霜寒登场，开启涌泉
title.en: Enter Zhao at full Frostbite to open Wellspring

input.zh: 接战中将满100霜寒的照从后台切入
input.en: Switch Zhao from off field while in combat with 100 Frostbite

trigger.zh: 霜寒已满且正在接战；开场资源只发一次，不按每次换人重发。
trigger.en: Frostbite is full and combat is active; the opening resource is not granted on every switch.

complete.zh: 确认登场消耗霜寒、开涌泉并给出快支；叶非明心获3剑势，已明心则转3载物，受上限限制。
complete.en: Confirm Frostbite spent, Wellspring opened and the assist offered; Ye gains three Sword Force outside Enlightened Mind or three Bearer inside it, subject to caps.

reason.zh: 照提供帷幕与加攻；登场视为快支，不要求先有普通快支提示。
reason.en: Zhao supplies Veil and ATK; her Entry counts as Quick Assist and does not require a pre-existing ordinary assist prompt.

fallback.zh: 霜寒没满不虚构登场：需要刷新时用可用EX补资源；仍没开帷幕就普通切回叶积攒。已有覆盖可直接返回叶。
fallback.en: Do not invent Entry below full Frostbite: an available EX may refill it; if no Veil opens, switch normally to Ye and rebuild. With sufficient coverage, return to Ye directly.

signal.zh: 按叶的资源条件或真实快支接手；满剑势登场和普通快支只做一种。
signal.en: Use Ye’s resource Entry or actual Quick Assist; execute only one.

title.zh: 叶按资源登场或接普通快支
title.en: Ye enters by resource or takes an ordinary Quick Assist

input.zh: 非明心且有6剑势时接战切入发动照影；未满6时只按真实快支提示入场
input.en: Outside Enlightened Mind with six Force, switch in during combat for Illuminating Darkness; below six take only a real Quick Assist prompt

trigger.zh: 满6且非明心的登场条件成立，或未满时存在指向叶的真实快支；两者择一。
trigger.en: Either the six-Force Entry condition is met outside Enlightened Mind, or a genuine ordinary assist targets Ye below six. Choose one.

complete.zh: 照影进入明心并升空；普通快支不会自动给6剑势或开启明心。记录本次是否真的进明心。
complete.en: Illuminating Darkness enters Enlightened Mind and the air; an ordinary assist does not grant six Force or Enlightened Mind. Record which actually happened.

reason.zh: 同一次换人不能计成登场加普通快支；响应照快支后允许她继续自动蓄力。
reason.en: One switch is not both an Entry and a second assist; responding to Zhao’s prompt permits her automatic charge.

fallback.zh: 无任一条件就普通切叶并跳过本事件；若已经明心，只按实际明心快支／普通换人回场，继续现有状态。
fallback.en: If neither condition holds, switch normally to Ye and skip this event. If already Enlightened, use the real Enlightened assist/normal return and continue that state.

actionLabel.zh: 照影／普通快支（按资源择一）
actionLabel.en: Illuminating Darkness / ordinary Quick Assist (choose by resources)

label.zh: 照的最终裁决 · 只有真实回应快支并进入自动蓄力才续招
label.en: Zhao Final Verdict · only after a real assist response starts automatic charging

title.en: Build Sword Force with normal-state EX and Basics

input.zh: 非明心时用就绪EX，再继续普攻；真实来招可用特殊技极限闪避接普攻
input.en: Outside Enlightened Mind use a ready EX, then Basics; against a real attack, Special can Perfect Dodge into Basics

trigger.zh: 非明心且未到6剑势；检查实际能量、敌人招式和已有载物。
trigger.en: Outside Enlightened Mind below six Force; check real energy, enemy actions and existing Bearer.

complete.zh: EX发动后给1剑势，其他招式按实际积攒；到6才可资源登场，不按固定几套普攻判满。
complete.en: EX grants one Force after activation; other buildup is read from the actual gauge. Resource Entry requires six, not an assumed Basic count.

reason.zh: 用常态动作补缺口；已明心时不能把这些动作当作常态EX继续补剑势。
reason.en: Fill the gap with normal-state actions; Enlightened attacks are not normal EX refills.

fallback.zh: 已进明心直接转对应输出；缺能量就普通攻击。需要补辅助时完成关键命中后普通切辅助。
fallback.en: If already Enlightened, use the matching damage sequence. Without energy use Basics; finish the current key hit before a needed support refresh.

title.zh: 常态满6后长按普攻进入明心
title.en: At six Force, hold Basic to enter Enlightened Mind

input.zh: 叶已在前台、非明心且满6时长按普攻
input.en: With Ye on field outside Enlightened Mind at six Force, hold Basic

trigger.zh: 辅助覆盖已建立，目标帷幕快照所需效果已提前施加。
trigger.en: Support coverage is established and required target effects precede the Veil snapshot.

complete.zh: 确认明心、决裁帷幕和空中状态；资源启动没有自动赋予本人消耗喧响Q的二段资格。
complete.en: Confirm Enlightened Mind, Verdict and airborne state; a resource entry does not grant the second-Ultimate entitlement from spending personal Decibels.

reason.zh: 把资源启动与本人Q、琉音升级Q分开，后续收尾由真实来源决定。
reason.en: Separate resource entry, personal Ultimate and Dialyn-upgraded Ultimate; the finisher depends on the actual entry source.

fallback.zh: 已经明心跳过，不长按误操作；不足6回积攒。若本人喧响已足，可改用本人Q启动；与琉音升级窗口择一，不连续使用。
fallback.en: Skip if already Enlightened; below six return to buildup. With sufficient personal Decibels, use her own Ultimate instead; choose this or Dialyn’s upgraded entry, not both consecutively.

prep.zh: 照开局100霜寒只支持一次登场；叶0影接第一次涌泉通常只得3剑势，仍须自行补缺口。
prep.en: Zhao’s opening 100 Frostbite supports one Entry; at M0 Ye normally gains only three Force from the first Wellspring and must build the remainder.

prep.zh: 若已通过接手进入明心，跳过常态积攒与重复登场，直接使用爆发中的输出段。
prep.en: If the entry already activated Enlightened Mind, skip normal buildup/re-entry and use the burst damage segment.

objective.zh: 明心结束后补资源；只在需要时刷新辅助。
objective.en: After Enlightened Mind ends, rebuild resources and refresh support only when needed.

title.en: Build Sword Force with normal-state EX and Basics

input.zh: 非明心时用就绪EX，再继续普攻；真实来招可用特殊技极限闪避接普攻
input.en: Outside Enlightened Mind use a ready EX, then Basics; against a real attack, Special can Perfect Dodge into Basics

trigger.zh: 非明心且未到6剑势；检查实际能量、敌人招式和已有载物。
trigger.en: Outside Enlightened Mind below six Force; check real energy, enemy actions and existing Bearer.

complete.zh: EX发动后给1剑势，其他招式按实际积攒；到6才可资源登场，不按固定几套普攻判满。
complete.en: EX grants one Force after activation; other buildup is read from the actual gauge. Resource Entry requires six, not an assumed Basic count.

reason.zh: 用常态动作补缺口；已明心时不能把这些动作当作常态EX继续补剑势。
reason.en: Fill the gap with normal-state actions; Enlightened attacks are not normal EX refills.

fallback.zh: 已进明心直接转对应输出；缺能量就普通攻击。需要补辅助时完成关键命中后普通切辅助。
fallback.en: If already Enlightened, use the matching damage sequence. Without energy use Basics; finish the current key hit before a needed support refresh.

signal.zh: 只在本阶段接下来需要刷新辅助时普通切过去；否则留叶继续。
signal.en: Switch normally only if the following support refresh is needed; otherwise keep Ye active.

title.zh: 先给目标挂布，再开叶的帷幕
title.en: Apply Paper before opening Ye’s Veil

input.zh: 普通切琉音；资源足时石头→剪刀→布，命中后切照
input.en: Switch normally to Dialyn; with resources use Rock → Scissors → Paper, then switch to Zhao

trigger.zh: 叶还没为本轮目标建立决裁帷幕易伤，或下一轮需要重建；每段EX能量与形态衔接满足。
trigger.en: Ye has not yet established this target’s Verdict vulnerability, or the next cycle needs setup; each EX has energy and a valid form window.

complete.zh: 确认布命中、恶意投诉有效，再让目标进入叶的新帷幕。好评不预设到90。
complete.en: Confirm Paper hits and Malicious Complaint is active before the target enters Ye’s new Veil. Do not prefill 90 Positive Reviews.

reason.zh: 叶读取目标进入帷幕当时的易伤，不能先开帷幕再补布却宣称本轮倍率追补。
reason.en: Ye reads vulnerability when the target enters the Veil; applying Paper afterward does not retroactively refresh that snapshot.

fallback.zh: 已覆盖可省EX，但琉音在前台时仍切照；叶已在明心境就保留现有窗口，勿为补布强行收尾。
fallback.en: Skip EX if covered, but still leave Dialyn for Zhao. If Ye is already Enlightened, preserve that window rather than forcing an early finisher for Paper.

signal.zh: 未满霜寒时普通切照补EX；已满切入会发动登场，此时跳过EX。普通换人不冒充快支。
signal.en: Below full Frostbite, switch normally to Zhao for EX; at full Frostbite the switch triggers Entry, so skip EX. A normal switch is not a Quick Assist.

title.en: Use Zhao EX to refill incomplete Frostbite

input.zh: 霜寒未满时普通切照、点EX；满值切入已登场则跳过本招
input.en: If Frostbite is not full, switch to Zhao and tap EX; skip this EX if a full-resource entry already occurred

trigger.zh: 确需补霜寒／治疗且能量足够；当前霜寒与已有帷幕已核对。
trigger.en: Frostbite/healing needs replenishment and energy suffices; check current Frostbite and existing Veil.

complete.zh: EX实际加20霜寒，满100才消耗开启涌泉；任意帷幕中可给快支，真正接手后照才自动蓄力。
complete.en: EX adds 20 Frostbite; only reaching 100 consumes it to open Wellspring. Inside any Veil it can offer Quick Assist; an actual response starts Zhao’s automatic charge.

reason.zh: 缩短所需资源的等待，但一次EX不保证开帷幕或给叶3剑势。
reason.en: Shorten resource recovery without assuming one EX always opens a Veil or gives Ye three Sword Force.

fallback.zh: 不缺资源就省EX；照在前台时仍回叶。无快支且叶不满6就普通换人；不能空按出登场。
fallback.en: Skip unnecessary EX, but still return from Zhao to Ye. Without an assist or six Sword Force, switch normally instead of inventing Entry.

signal.zh: 叶满6且非明心可登场；否则只接真实快支，无提示普通切人。
signal.en: Ye may enter at six Force outside Enlightened Mind; otherwise take a real assist or switch normally.

title.zh: 叶按资源登场或接普通快支
title.en: Ye enters by resource or takes an ordinary Quick Assist

input.zh: 非明心且有6剑势时接战切入发动照影；未满6时只按真实快支提示入场
input.en: Outside Enlightened Mind with six Force, switch in during combat for Illuminating Darkness; below six take only a real Quick Assist prompt

trigger.zh: 满6且非明心的登场条件成立，或未满时存在指向叶的真实快支；两者择一。
trigger.en: Either the six-Force Entry condition is met outside Enlightened Mind, or a genuine ordinary assist targets Ye below six. Choose one.

complete.zh: 照影进入明心并升空；普通快支不会自动给6剑势或开启明心。记录本次是否真的进明心。
complete.en: Illuminating Darkness enters Enlightened Mind and the air; an ordinary assist does not grant six Force or Enlightened Mind. Record which actually happened.

reason.zh: 同一次换人不能计成登场加普通快支；响应照快支后允许她继续自动蓄力。
reason.en: One switch is not both an Entry and a second assist; responding to Zhao’s prompt permits her automatic charge.

fallback.zh: 无任一条件就普通切叶并跳过本事件；若已经明心，只按实际明心快支／普通换人回场，继续现有状态。
fallback.en: If neither condition holds, switch normally to Ye and skip this event. If already Enlightened, use the real Enlightened assist/normal return and continue that state.

actionLabel.zh: 照影／普通快支（按资源择一）
actionLabel.en: Illuminating Darkness / ordinary Quick Assist (choose by resources)

label.zh: 照的最终裁决 · 只有真实回应快支并进入自动蓄力才续招
label.en: Zhao Final Verdict · only after a real assist response starts automatic charging

prep.zh: 已有辅助覆盖则省略中间刷新并留叶积攒；已经切到辅助时仍明确切回叶。
prep.en: With sufficient support coverage, skip the refresh and keep Ye building resources; if already on support, explicitly return to Ye.

prep.zh: 照满霜寒切入时改走开局登场，不再强制追加EX；没满且EX不足则正常回场继续积攒。
prep.en: At full Frostbite, Zhao uses the opening Entry route rather than a forced extra EX; with incomplete resource and no EX, return normally and rebuild.

objective.zh: 确认启动来源，再按命中与资源执行空地衔接。
objective.en: Confirm the entry source, then link aerial/ground attacks using actual hits and resources.

title.zh: 叶尚未明心时，琉音送客开升级窗口
title.en: Use Dialyn Get Lost! only before Ye enters Enlightened Mind

input.zh: 普通切琉音，长按普攻送客；真实升级窗口选择叶
input.en: Switch normally to Dialyn and hold Basic for Get Lost!; select Ye in the actual upgraded prompt

trigger.zh: 叶当前非明心；照增益及目标恶意投诉有效，琉音有客诉且好评至少90。
trigger.en: Ye is not Enlightened; Zhao buffs and target Malicious Complaint hold, and Dialyn has Complaint plus at least 90 Positive Reviews.

complete.zh: 自然窗口升级消耗60好评，强制开窗消耗90；强制窗口不证明真实失衡。
complete.en: A natural upgrade spends 60 Reviews; forcing a window spends 90. A forced window does not prove Stun.

reason.zh: 避免明心已开时再升级出收尾Q、提前结束本轮；先确认叶的实际形态。
reason.en: Avoid upgrading into a finisher after Enlightened Mind is already active; confirm Ye’s actual state first.

fallback.zh: 叶已明心则跳过本步和下一步并留叶输出；若人在琉音，普通切回叶继续现有状态。资源不够则用照影／本人Q路线。
fallback.en: If Ye is already Enlightened, skip this and the next event and keep her active; if already on Dialyn, switch normally back. With insufficient resources use Entry/personal Ultimate instead.

signal.zh: 仅在真实升级连携窗口中选当前非明心的叶。
signal.en: Select non-Enlightened Ye only in the real upgraded Chain prompt.

title.zh: 接琉音升级的逐云惊霆

input.zh: 在琉音升级窗口选择叶；不重复按本人Q
input.en: Select Ye in Dialyn’s upgraded prompt; do not also press her personal Ultimate

trigger.zh: 紧接琉音送客，真实升级提示可用，叶当前非明心。
trigger.en: Immediately after Dialyn Get Lost!, the actual upgrade prompt is available and Ye is not Enlightened.

complete.zh: 确认进入明心、得到6剑势并升空；没有本人耗喧响记录就不赋予免费二段Q资格。
complete.en: Confirm Enlightened Mind, six Force and airborne state; without personal Decibels being spent, do not grant the free second-Ultimate entitlement.

reason.zh: 免费启动与后续收尾分开；6影可另按真实明灯愿替代。
reason.en: Separate a free starter from finisher eligibility; M6 may separately replace it using actual Lantern Wish.

fallback.zh: 没有升级提示就跳过，不按普通快支假装终结技；回常态资源路线。
fallback.en: Without the upgrade prompt, skip rather than pretending an ordinary assist was an Ultimate; return to normal resource setup.

title.zh: 空中斩流光·灭，再接斩流光·极

input.zh: 空中点特殊技快速下砸，再点普攻接极；长窗口可先打空中普攻再下砸
input.en: In the air tap Special for the quick slam, then Basic for Maximum; a longer window may include aerial Basics first

trigger.zh: 已明心且处于空中，至少3剑势足够支付两次命中；目标仍可输出。
trigger.en: Enlightened and airborne, with at least three Force to pay for both hits, and a hittable target.

complete.zh: 灭命中实际消耗2剑势并获得观止；极命中再消耗1，随后查看剩余剑势／观止。
complete.en: Annihilation hitting spends two Force and grants Culmination; Maximum hitting spends one more. Recheck Force and Culmination.

reason.zh: 拆开作者短轴的起手，避免把地面普通E误当作空中下砸。
reason.en: Make the short-sequence opener explicit instead of mistaking a grounded Special for the airborne slam.

fallback.zh: 仍在地面时先用合法普攻衔接扶摇势升空；资源或窗口不足则用可用攻击收尾，不硬凑。
fallback.en: If grounded, use the legal Basic chain into Skyward Ascent first. With insufficient resources/window, use available attacks and finish rather than forcing the sequence.

title.en: Tap Soaring Light and use Culmination for its cost

input.zh: 斩流光·极后，在合法衔接窗口点特殊技打一段飞光并升空
input.en: After Maximum, tap Special in its valid follow-up window for one Soaring Light and ascend

trigger.zh: 当前有剑势并满足极后的飞光派生，或实际界面仍明确允许该派生；观止只替代消耗，不能据此保证0剑势也能启动。
trigger.en: Sword Force and the post-Maximum follow-up condition hold, or the actual interface explicitly permits it. Culmination substitutes the cost; it does not alone guarantee activation at zero Force.

complete.zh: 观止优先替代剑势消耗；核对实际派生和空中状态，未触发就不记为已升空。
complete.en: Culmination replaces Force consumption first; verify the real follow-up and airborne state instead of assuming ascent.

reason.zh: 基础短轴用单段飞光连接下一组，不长按额外透支剑势。
reason.en: The base short sequence uses one Soaring Light to connect the next group without holding to overspend Force.

fallback.zh: 派生不满足就用实际可用升空／收尾路径；2影长按扩展按配置说明和库存决定。
fallback.en: If unavailable, use a legal ascent/finisher. M2 held extensions depend on the configuration note and real stock.

title.zh: 窗口足够再打一组灭→极→飞光
title.en: Repeat Annihilation → Maximum → Soaring Light if the window allows

input.zh: 确认已升空后，点特殊技→普攻→合法单段飞光；每段看实际命中和库存
input.en: After confirming airborne state, Special → Basic → a legal single Soaring Light; check each hit and resource count

trigger.zh: 至少3剑势、明心仍在，且目标能承受这一组；不是固定必须完成两组。
trigger.en: At least three Force, Enlightened Mind still active, and the target/window permit the group; two groups are not compulsory.

complete.zh: 确认灭与极的2+1实际消耗；最后飞光仅在合法派生成立时计入。若已0剑势且没有飞光提示，直接按真实收尾技能结束。
complete.en: Confirm the actual 2+1 cost of Annihilation and Maximum; count the final Soaring Light only if legally available. At zero Force without a Soaring Light prompt, proceed directly to the true finisher.

reason.zh: 把作者重复段变成状态条件；失手或少资源时及时缩短。
reason.en: Make the authored repeated segment conditional, shortening it after a miss or with less resource.

fallback.zh: 不够3剑势或目标要离场就跳过重复段，执行当前可用收尾；2影不要预填9观止。
fallback.en: Below three Force or with the target leaving, skip the repetition and use an available finisher; M2 does not prefill nine Culmination.

title.zh: 按本次资格选择归尘／斩妄开天
title.en: Choose Return to Dust / Cleaving Heavens from actual eligibility

input.zh: 明心中按终结技键收尾；剑势耗尽也可长按特殊技，按当前显示招式择一
input.en: In Enlightened Mind press Ultimate to finish; after Force is exhausted, held Special is another input. Execute the currently available move once

trigger.zh: 明心仍在且准备结束；本人耗喧响逐云惊霆或6影明灯愿达到替代条件，才使用斩妄开天。
trigger.en: Enlightened Mind remains and the window is ending. Cleaving Heavens requires a personal Decibel-paid Chasing Storms or the M6 Lantern Wish replacement condition.

complete.zh: 确认实际归尘或斩妄开天完成，退出明心并将载物转回剑势；两种收尾不能重复做。
complete.en: Confirm the actual finisher, exit Enlightened Mind, and convert Bearer back to Force; do not perform/count both finishers.

reason.zh: 按Q键可能发动的是EX归尘；琉音免费升级第一Q在低影下不会给第二Q资格。
reason.en: The Ultimate key can trigger EX Return to Dust; Dialyn’s free first Ultimate does not grant the second Ultimate at lower Mindscapes.

fallback.zh: 本次没有二段资格就用归尘，不等待新的满喧响；若仍有有效输出窗口可延后收尾。
fallback.en: Without second-Ultimate entitlement, use Return to Dust instead of waiting for full Decibels; delay the finisher while a useful window remains.

actionLabel.zh: 归尘／斩妄开天（按资格择一）
actionLabel.en: Return to Dust / Cleaving Heavens (choose by eligibility)

prep.zh: 辅助准备应在窗口前完成；叶已明心则跳过本阶段启动事件。
prep.en: Finish support setup before the window; if Ye is already Enlightened, skip this phase’s starter events.

prep.zh: 空中／地面、剑势、观止与当前技能可用性都需确认；短轴示例不保证任意敌人都容纳两组。
prep.en: Check airborne/grounded state, Force, Culmination and move availability; the short example does not guarantee two groups against every enemy.

text.zh: 叶1影开场给6剑势，不是每次进场都给；仍先布置辅助，再用资源登场。
text.en: Ye M1 grants six Force at battle start, not on every switch; establish support before resource entry.

text.zh: 叶2影载物上限6、观止上限9；只按真实消耗剑势累积。末段飞光当前可用且库存足时可长按扩展，不直接套用满9或固定三连明心。
text.en: Ye M2 raises Bearer to six and Culmination to nine; build them from real Force spending. Extend the final Soaring Light only if available and stocked, not from assumed nine stacks or three guaranteed windows.

text.zh: 叶4影开场喧响只发一次；提高帷幕易伤上限，不自动给敌人最高易伤。
text.en: Ye M4 opening Decibels are granted once; a higher Veil cap does not automatically grant maximum vulnerability.

text.zh: 叶6影明灯愿按开场与每次实际进入明心累计；持有3层才把归尘替换为斩妄开天，并消耗3层。
text.en: Ye M6 Lantern Wish accrues at battle start and actual Enlightened entries; three stacks replace Return to Dust with Cleaving Heavens and are then consumed.

text.zh: 照1影要真实切为非当前角色才给减抗效果；只站场开帷幕不等于已触发。
text.en: Zhao M1 requires actually becoming non-active for its RES-ignore effect; opening a Veil on field alone does not trigger it.

text.zh: 照2影的加攻要求照实际回复生命；不要把放特殊技或满血状态直接视为完成治疗。
text.en: Zhao M2 ATK needs her actual HP recovery; do not equate using Special or being at full HP with healing.

text.zh: 叶专武的增伤与暴伤由本人开启帷幕触发；照先开帷幕不等于叶专武已触发。
text.en: Ye’s signature DMG/CRIT DMG bonus triggers when she opens a Veil; Zhao opening one is not Ye’s trigger.

text.zh: 照专武的暴伤需本人开／延长帷幕；能量回复改善循环，不保证每次EX或登场就绪。
text.en: Zhao’s signature CRIT DMG needs her own Veil activation/extension; energy recovery does not guarantee every EX or Entry.

text.zh: 琉音1影更快积累好评，仍看90门槛与客诉；不固定每次三段EX都能升级。
text.en: Dialyn M1 builds Reviews faster but still needs 90 and Complaint; three EX attacks do not guarantee an upgrade.

text.zh: 琉音2影提高恶意投诉效果，仍须在叶目标入帷幕前施加；不当作已开帷幕后的追补。
text.en: Dialyn M2 improves Malicious Complaint but it must precede the target entering Ye’s Veil; it is not a retroactive snapshot update.

text.zh: 琉音专武需要实际物理EX伤害叠层；不因有专武就假设满层或开局升级就绪。
text.en: Dialyn’s signature needs actual physical EX damage for stacks; equipping it does not prove full stacks or an opening upgrade.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.先给目标挂布，再开叶的帷幕: 强化特殊技依次打石头、剪刀、布
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.照满霜寒登场，开启涌泉: 满100霜寒时从后台切入照
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.叶按资源登场或接普通快支: 叶按6剑势登场，或接实际快支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.常态EX与普攻补剑势: 用强化特殊技和普攻攒剑势
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.常态满6后长按普攻进入明心: 非明心且满6剑势时长按普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.照未满霜寒时用EX补充: 霜寒未满时点强化特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.叶尚未明心时，琉音送客开升级窗口: 琉音长按普攻，等升级连携窗口
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.接琉音升级的逐云惊霆: 在升级连携窗口选叶，不另按终结技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.空中斩流光·灭，再接斩流光·极: 空中点特殊技下砸，再点普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.点按飞光，用观止代付: 打完「极」后点特殊技升空
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.窗口足够再打一组灭→极→飞光: 空中点特殊技、点普攻，再点特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.按本次资格选择归尘／斩妄开天: 明心中按终结技键，按实际资格收尾

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切琉音；资源足时石头→剪刀→布，命中后切照: 琉音在场且能量足够时，在替换窗口内依次按三次强化特殊技打出石头、剪刀、布；等布命中再切照。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.接战中将满100霜寒的照从后台切入: 接战中，看后台照的霜寒；满100时切入照即可发动登场技。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.霜寒未满时普通切照、点EX；满值切入已登场则跳过本招: 霜寒未满时普通切照，再按强化特殊技补霜寒；若刚才满霜寒切入已发动登场技，跳过这招。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切琉音，长按普攻送客；真实升级窗口选择叶: 琉音在场时长按普攻发动「送客」；如果出现真正的升级连携选项，选择叶瞬光。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.在琉音升级窗口选择叶；不重复按本人Q: 在升级连携选项中选择叶瞬光，不要再额外按她自己的终结技。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.空中点特殊技快速下砸，再点普攻接极；长窗口可先打空中普攻再下砸: 空中点按特殊技快速下砸，接着点普攻；若窗口足够长，可以先打空中普攻再下砸。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.斩流光·极后，在合法衔接窗口点特殊技打一段飞光并升空: 地面的「极」打完、能衔接时点一下特殊技，打一段飞光并升空。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.确认已升空后，点特殊技→普攻→合法单段飞光；每段看实际命中和库存: 确认已升空后，点按特殊技下砸 → 点按普攻 → 在可衔接时再点一次特殊技；每段都看实际命中和剩余资源。

143100007: 已升空后可直接用特殊技下砸，再在有剑势时点普攻接「极」；下砸之前的空中普攻只在窗口够时选打。
From the air, dive with Special, then use Basic for the follow-up if Sword Force remains. Airborne Basics before the dive are optional if the window allows.
143100010: 不需用普攻解锁强化特殊技；本路线用强化特殊技后再打普攻积剑势，没有指定必须打到哪一段。
No Basic prerequisite for EX. This route uses Basics after EX to build Sword Force, without a fixed hit-count requirement.
143100012: 这一步从地面「极」后接一段强化特殊技；升空的扶摇势自动衔接，不要再按普攻。
Link a single EX after the grounded slash here. The Basic that lifts Ye into the air follows automatically; no additional Basic input.
143100023: 本路线已在前台，非明心时有6剑势就长按普攻。后台按资源条件换入是另一入口，不需要补按这一下。
For this on-field route, hold Basic at six Sword Force outside the stance. The off-field switch-in route does not require the extra Basic.
148100003: 持有客诉时长按普攻就是「送客」；不要求先点普攻，也不是按强化特殊技键。
With a Customer Complaint, hold Basic to use the send-off; no preliminary Basic taps or separate EX press.

143100004: 普通攻击：明心境·扶摇势
Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
143100005: 普通攻击：明心境·斩流光 极
Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
143100006: 普通攻击：明心境·斩流光
143100007: 普通攻击：明心境·斩流光 灭
Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
143100012: 强化特殊技：明心境·飞光
EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light

1431:opening-ye-enter: 游戏把两种入口都列在「照影」：非明心、有6点剑势，前台长按普攻；在后台则接战时切入。本步用前台入口。
Both inputs belong to this Entry Skill. Outside Enlightened Mind with 6 Force, hold Basic on field, or switch in from the back during combat. Use the on-field input here.
